name: A Dynamite Plan
summary: A Dynamite Plan is a task offered by the inventive tinkerer Sprite Jumpsprocket in Stormwind's Dwarven District. Excited by talk of industrial sabotage, she seeks a sizable stash of coarse dynamite to kick-start the plan. Adventurers must manufacture or acquire the munitions to support her scheming.

sections.title: Sparks in the Dwarven District
sections.body: Amid the clatter and smoke of Stormwind's Dwarven District, gnome engineer Sprite Jumpsprocket is rarely one to shy away from radical solutions. When talk turns to industrial sabotage, her immediate instinct is not caution, but enthusiasm. As a first step, she enlists passing mercenaries to supply her with a bundle of coarse dynamite.

sections.title: Gnomish Ambitions
sections.body: Procuring the explosives requires a capable hand at an engineering workbench or a knack for trading among the city's craftsmen. Ten sticks of coarse dynamite provide more than enough firepower to disrupt whatever industrial schemes are unfolding in the surrounding territories, demonstrating the practical, if perilous, methods gnomes favor when solving mechanical and political disruptions alike.

faq.answer: Sprite Jumpsprocket is an engineer found working among the smithies and workshops of the Dwarven District in Stormwind City. She is known for pursuing audacious and volatile engineering projects.

faq.q: What does Sprite need for this task?
faq.answer: She requires ten sticks of coarse dynamite. These can be manufactured using engineering techniques or acquired through trade and the auction house from other crafters.

faq.q: Why does Sprite want coarse dynamite?
faq.answer: The prospect of industrial sabotage has caught Sprite's attention, and she means to start the job with a dependable stockpile of basic blasting charges.

faq.q: Where do I turn in the quest?
faq.answer: Sprite Jumpsprocket is located in the Dwarven District within the walls of Stormwind City.

faq.q: Is engineering required to complete this quest?
faq.answer: No, engineering is not strictly required. While engineers can craft the coarse dynamite themselves, any adventurer can trade with players or buy the required dynamite from the auction house.

faq.q: How does this relate to broader troubles around Stormwind?
faq.answer: Sprite never says what her sabotage is aimed at. All she reveals is her eagerness: the moment industrial sabotage comes up, she wants to start with dynamite.

angles.text: Engineers can craft coarse dynamite using coarse blasting powder and linen cloth, making this task a straightforward test of early tinkercraft.
Sprite Jumpsprocket exemplifies the classic gnomish impulse: meeting complicated industrial problems with clever, combustible contraptions.
Sprite runs her explosive scheme from the Dwarven District, right inside the walls of the Alliance capital.
